evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of persistent hypertension despite treatment with three
agents.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 52 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 144 ms, QRS 93 ms, QTc 453
ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normal tracing.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
55%. Mild left atrial enlargement.No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 140 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.9 mmol/L
Chloride: 104 mmol/L
CO2: 29 mmol/L
BUN: 15 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 125 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.0 mg/dL

Amlodipine 10 mg by mouth once daily
Losartan 100 mg by mouth once daily
Chlorthalidone 25 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 75 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.

sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
